rationale: The assistant correctly put airflow first, then narrowed the fault to the heater circuit (thermal cut-out or element) without claiming certainty. It declined to name a part because the full model is unknown and no test has been done, and it advised an engineer since the customer has no meter. Minor weaknesses: the first reply was long and partly repeated checks the customer had already done, and it did not ask about a resettable cut-out or reset button, though the customer later mentioned none was visible. The reply also implied a reset/cut-out might be involved without saying whether it is one-shot.
